doc_summary: `native_camera_distance(partial, mirrored, entity, distance)` receives the final scaled maximum distance for a third-person camera, before the existing eight visual-shape collision rays shorten it. `entity` is the camera entity view, including optional living scale/distance and mount scale/distance; this covers player and spectator-mob cameras. `mirrored` identifies front-facing third person. Only finite values in 0..=1024 blocks are accepted, keeping mod requests within the collision-ray budget; other values retain the original distance. First-person views and title panoramas do not fire it. Bundles need "hooks": @API:camera_distance@.
